statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and transient loss of consciousness
There is concern for symptomatic sick sinus syndrome
The service is to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service is to assess the efficacy of current management
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The service was rejected because coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
Prairie State Medicaid is the secondary payer
